title: thuja occidentalis f. pumila
intro: Thuja occidentalis f. pumila, commonly known as American Arborvitae, is a compact, evergreen shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used to support the immune system, reduce stress, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thuja occidentalis f. pumila include expectorant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for relieving coughs, colds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include thujone, borneol, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
